components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled button for the next step.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #D23F0C; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-primary-action:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Neutral action on a grouped surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1e2227; font: 600 16px system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary-action:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-secondary-action:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-secondary-action { background: #212429; color: #f1f2f3; } } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } }

components.name: Grouped settings
components.description: Inset dividers separate individual settings inside a shared surface.
components.html: <section class="ds-group"><button class="ds-settings-row" type="button">Security Center<svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg></button><button class="ds-settings-row" type="button">Trash<svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg></button></section>
components.css: .ds-group { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1e2227; } .ds-settings-row { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 13px 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 16px system-ui; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-row + .ds-settings-row::before { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 16px; height: 0.5px; background: #ebe8e3; content: ""; } .ds-settings-row svg { color: #5f656c; } .ds-settings-row:hover, .ds-settings-row:active { background: #faf9f7; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-group { background: #212429; color: #f1f2f3; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-settings-row + .ds-settings-row::before { background: #2f343b; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-settings-row svg { color: #a0a7ae; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-settings-row:hover, .ds-settings-row:active { background: #1c1f23; } } .ds-settings-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-settings-row:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } } .ds-settings-row:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: A persistent label identifies a theme-aware native text input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #5f656c; font: 600 13px system-ui; } .ds-field-input { min-width: 0; min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1px solid #ebe8e3; border-radius: 14px; background: #faf9f7; color: #1e2227; font: 400 16px system-ui; box-sizing: border-box; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field { color: #a0a7ae; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field-input { border-color: #2f343b; background: #1c1f23; color: #f1f2f3; } } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } }

components.name: Global search trigger
components.description: The Vault entry opens the shared search modal.
components.css: .ds-search-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 46px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; gap: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #faf9f7; color: #5f656c; font: 400 16px system-ui; cursor: pointer; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-search-trigger { background: #1c1f23; color: #a0a7ae; } } .ds-search-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-search-trigger:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } }

components.name: Category dropdown
components.description: The current category opens a selection sheet.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-category" aria-label="Categories, All items">All items<svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #1e2227; font: 600 17px system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-category svg { color: #5f656c; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-category { color: #f1f2f3; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-category svg { color: #a0a7ae; } } .ds-category:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-category:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } }

components.name: Bottom tab bar
components.description: The active tab uses the mode-specific link color.
components.css: .ds-tab-bar { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid #ebe8e3; background: #FFFFFF; color: #5f656c; } .ds-tab { display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 2px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 49px; padding: 4px 2px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 11px system-ui; overflow-wrap: anywhere; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab[aria-current] { color: #b83c0a; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tab-bar { border-color: #2f343b; background: #212429; color: #a0a7ae; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tab[aria-current] { color: #ff9a70; } } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Folder row
components.description: A folder name and child count sit beside a neutral type glyph and a separate action menu.
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 0.5px solid #ebe8e3; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1e2227; } .ds-file-open { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 78px; padding: 14px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; font: 400 16px system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-file-glyph { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 10px; background: #faf9f7; color: #5f656c; } .ds-file-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-file-copy strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-file-copy small { color: #5f656c; font-size: 13px; } .ds-file-menu { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 54px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #5f656c; cursor: pointer; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-file-row { border-color: #2f343b; background: #212429; color: #f1f2f3; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-file-glyph { background: #1c1f23; color: #c3c8ce; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-file-copy small, .ds-file-menu { color: #a0a7ae; } } .ds-file-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-file-open:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } } .ds-file-menu:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b83c0a; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-file-menu:focus-visible { outline-color: #ff9a70; } }

narrative.overview:
The vault opens on its contents. A compact title bar and quiet grouped rows help people find, inspect, and copy items, then return to where they were.

The transparent ghost and orange accents carry the My Secret identity. Native stacks, tabs, keyboards, and pickers give the app familiar behavior on iOS and Android.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral light surfaces and charcoal dark surfaces follow device appearance.
System typography and recognizable Lucide glyphs keep rows easy to scan.
A category dropdown, one global search, and a dedicated Files tab give each task a clear entry point.
dos: Do keep search, item actions, and reading order consistent across themes and device widths.
Do use accessible labels for icon-only controls and keep icons decorative when visible text already names the action.
Do use the ghost illustration for onboarding and empty states and Lucide glyphs for routine navigation and rows.
Do use synthetic vault contents for review captures. Record coverage for each current build, device class, appearance, and text size that was checked.
